newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: North Flinders 9 mth profit falls four pct.
newsitem.headline: North Flinders 9 mth profit falls four pct.

text.p: Gold miner North Flinders Mines Ltd said on Wednesday that net profit in the nine months to March 31 fell four percent to A$26.24 million from A$27.34 million a year earlier.

The company, which is part of the Normandy Mining Ltd group, said third quarter net profit was A$11.77 million, 59 percent above the second quarter. It did not issue year-ago figures on a quarterly basis.
Gold sales in the latest quarter rose to 62,004 ounces from 56,734 ounces in the second quarter at an average realised price of A$600 per ounce, a rise of A$20 on the previous quarter.
Gold production rose 11 percent to 62,638 ounces compared with the second quarter, driven by a four percent rise in mill throughput and an eight percent rise in head grade.
